comment:
* Helper class that keeps temporary state while {LayoutManager} is filling out the empty
     * space.

variables.name: mRecycle
variables.comment: * We may not want to recycle children in some cases (e.g. layout)

variables.name: mOffset
variables.comment: * Pixel offset where layout should start

variables.name: mAvailable
variables.comment: * Number of pixels that we should fill, in the layout direction.

variables.name: mCurrentPosition
variables.comment: * Current position on the adapter to get the next item.

variables.name: mItemDirection
variables.comment:
* Defines the direction in which the data adapter is traversed.
         * Should be {@link #ITEM_DIRECTION_HEAD} or {@link #ITEM_DIRECTION_TAIL}

variables.name: mLayoutDirection
variables.comment:
* Defines the direction in which the layout is filled.
         * Should be {@link #LAYOUT_START} or {@link #LAYOUT_END}

variables.name: mScrollingOffset
variables.comment:
* Used when LayoutState is constructed in a scrolling state.
         * It should be set the amount of scrolling we can make without creating a new view.
         * Settings this is required for efficient view recycling.

variables.name: mExtra
variables.comment:
* Used if you want to pre-layout items that are not yet visible.
         * The difference with {@link #mAvailable} is that, when recycling, distance laid out for
         * {@link #mExtra} is not considered to avoid recycling visible children.

variables.name: mIsPreLayout
variables.comment:
* Equal to {@link RecyclerView.State#isPreLayout()}. When consuming scrap, if this value
         * is set to true, we skip removed views since they should not be laid out in post layout
         * step.

variables.name: mLastScrollDelta
variables.comment:
* The most recent {@link #scrollBy(int, RecyclerView.Recycler, RecyclerView.State)}
         * amount.

variables.name: mScrapList
variables.comment:
* When LLM needs to layout particular views, it sets this list in which case, LayoutState
         * will only return views from this list and return null if it cannot find an item.

variables.name: mInfinite
variables.comment: * Used when there is no limit in how many views can be laid out.

methods.name: boolean hasMore(RecyclerView.State state)
methods.comment: * @return true if there are more items in the data adapter

methods.name: View next(RecyclerView.Recycler recycler)
methods.comment:
* Gets the view for the next element that we should layout.
         * Also updates current item index to the next item, based on {@link #mItemDirection}
         *
         * @return The next element that we should layout.

methods.name: private View nextViewFromScrapList()
methods.comment:
* Returns the next item from the scrap list. *

* Upon finding a valid VH, sets current item position to VH.itemPosition + mItemDirection * * @return View if an item in the current position or direction exists if not null.
